privacy.metaDescription: How MathFormula collects, uses, and protects your data when you use MathFormula.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy for MathFormula
privacy.introductionBody: We value your privacy. This policy explains how we handle user data when you use MathFormula (MathFormula). We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about our practices.
privacy.dataCollectionItem1: We collect email addresses via Supabase when you create an account or sign in, for authentication and secure account management.
privacy.dataCollectionItem2: Images you upload for formula scanning may be processed through Google Gemini and OpenRouter APIs. We may also collect limited technical information (such as browser or device type) needed to run and protect the service.
privacy.imageProcessingLead: Uploaded images are processed in real-time using Google Gemini and OpenRouter APIs.
privacy.imageProcessingEmphasis: We do not store your original images on our servers unless you save them to your Personal Library.
privacy.dataSecurityBody: We use industry-standard security practices and encryption provided by our infrastructure partners, including Vercel (hosting) and Supabase (authentication and database), to protect data in transit and at rest.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: We do not sell or trade your personal information to outside parties for marketing. Service providers (hosting, authentication, AI APIs) process data only as needed to operate the product, in line with this policy and their terms.

terms.accuracyLead: MathFormula is an AI-powered tool. We provide results as is. AI may produce errors—please verify results independently.
terms.accuracyBody: The developer (Berkan Urek) does not guarantee 100% accuracy in mathematical calculations or interpretations. Users should verify results independently before relying on them for academic, professional, or financial decisions.
terms.userConductIntro: You agree not to misuse the Service. In particular:
terms.userConductItem1: You must not upload malicious files or attempt to disrupt or compromise our systems.
terms.userConductItem2: You must not upload copyrighted or other material without permission when doing so would violate applicable law or third-party rights.
terms.liabilityBody: The Service is intended for educational and general purposes; no professional guarantee is provided. To the fullest extent permitted by law, the developer is not responsible for any academic, financial, or other loss or damage arising from your use of or reliance on the Service, including errors or omissions in AI-generated or computed output.

hero.title: Convert Math to Word Instantly
hero.subtitle: Write, browse, or scan formulas with AI. The ultimate workspace for LaTeX, MathML, and professional exports.

workspace.howToUseBody:
Scan Image — Upload or paste a screenshot; AI reads the formula and fills LaTeX (with a backup service if the primary API is busy).
Calculate — Get a numeric value for expressions, or tap after typing an equation with = (e.g. x^2+2x+1=0) to see solutions.
Copy for Word — Copies MathML you can paste into Microsoft Word.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: MathFormula turns LaTeX into Word-ready MathML and keeps your personal formulas organized—built for coursework, research, and technical writing.

1.title: Write or browse
1.description: Use the Formula Workspace to compose LaTeX visually, scan formulas with AI, or open the Formula Library and insert curated expressions.

2.title: Convert for Word
2.description: When you are ready, copy as MathML designed for Microsoft Word. Paste into your document and Word treats it as an editable equation.

3.title: Save and manage
3.description: Sign in to save custom formulas to your private library. Search, edit, copy, or remove entries anytime from My Library.
